title: Urgent Requirement: Certified Electrician for Community Hall Wiring
body: Need an experienced licensed electrician to overhaul fuse distribution board and stage lighting fixtures at Pappanamcode NSS Karayogam auditorium. Daily wages provided.

title: Volunteer Call: Monsoon Canal Clearing & Sapling Planting Drive
body: Join local residents and NSS students this Saturday morning to plant 50 native shade trees along Karamana river walk and remove plastic waste. Refreshments and certificates provided.

title: Plumber Needed for Residents Association Overhead Tank Valve Repair
body: Experienced plumbing technician needed to replace 2-inch gate valve and check leak in community overhead reservoir at Mudavanmugal.
